name: Nebula
author: Erin Carter
description: The Pillars of Creation as a backdrop — two or three towering dark gas columns rise from the bottom against a softly glowing emission backdrop whose hue drifts across the palette with height. An unseen star above the frame lights each pillar's tip and edge with a thin photoevaporation rim while faint wisps peel off the crowns and dissolve downwind. Structure-first: dark vertical towers, not an amorphous cloud, with zero points of light.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: Scales the backdrop billowing and the wisp streaming speed; 0 freezes the scene, high values make the gas visibly flow off the pillar tips.

params.label: Pillar width
params.effect: Base width of the dark columns in CSS pixels, from slender spires to massive trunks filling the lower frame.

params.label: Rim
params.effect: Brightness of the photoevaporation rim on tips and lit edges, from plain unlit silhouettes to fiercely lit crowns.

params.label: Erosion
params.effect: FBM raggedness of the pillar silhouettes, from clean smooth columns to deeply gnawed, wispy-edged towers.
